# GetPersistedSpecImplementation

Read-only exposure of persisted implementation links — the durable archived traceability record.

## Rules

- `execute` input `GetPersistedSpecImplementationInput`: specId (required, fully-qualified spec identity).
- Resolve spec workspace repository, call SpecRepository.readPersistedState(spec). MUST NOT read spec-lock.json directly; MUST NOT materialize or read generated metadata to answer this query.
- Persisted state exists → GetPersistedSpecImplementationResult: specId (fully-qualified), implementation (exact readonly PersistedImplementationLink[] from snapshot, stored order), initialized true. Each link preserves file-level (symbols absent) vs symbol-level (symbols present non-empty) distinction unchanged from storage.
- readPersistedState returns null → result with implementation [] and initialized false. MUST NOT create persisted state as side effect of this read.
- Spec identity unresolvable to existing spec artifact set in its workspace → throw SpecNotFoundError.
- Config factory createGetPersistedSpecImplementation(config, options?) derives deps via resolveGetPersistedSpecImplementationDeps(resolver) then delegates to canonical createGetPersistedSpecImplementation(deps). Resolver provides: specs ReadonlyMap<string, SpecRepository> (one repository instance per workspace). Helper is the only use-case-specific composition entry; factory MUST NOT reconstruct fs-shaped wiring inline.

## Constraints

- Strictly read-only — never creates, mutates, or writes persisted state
- Returned list = durable archived traceability record; NOT autodetected candidates or in-progress change tracking state
- readOnly workspace ownership does not affect this operation — reads always permitted
